items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: The second place band was a six piece bebop band led by Paul Winter.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, yeah sure. And so but I don’t know, when I was in high school, that’s when I really got the bug. And a buddy of mine took me to hear Dizzy Gillespie one night, he was adjudicating a festival at Georgetown University. The second place band was a six piece bebop band led by Paul Winter.
